Route 2: Solvothermal reduction in ethanol  
1. Dissolve Na₂Se (0.5 g) in ethanol (40 mL) and add ascorbic acid (0.2 g) as a reducing agent; adjust pH to 2.5 with dilute HCl (0.1 M, 1 mL).  
2. Transfer the solution to an autoclave and heat at 180 °C for 6 h.  
3. Cool, collect the solid by centrifugation, wash with ethanol, and dry at 50 °C.  
Final product: Se obtained as hexagonal nanorods approximately 5.0 μm length × 0.05 μm width × 0.05 μm depth, matching PDF reference 00-014-0256.
